title: feat: harden desktop packaging and clean-install verification
body:
## P7 — Desktop delivery

Stacked after PR #21 (`completion/product-polish`); PRs #17–#21 remain draft.

- retains Tauri NSIS, MSI, deb, and AppImage targets with stable metadata, current-user Start Menu/uninstall, upgrade code, and app-owned data persistence
- adds deterministic target-specific package normalization and SHA256 manifest generation
- adds package verification plus Windows NSIS install/start/restart/uninstall and Linux deb/AppImage smoke paths when runner tooling permits
- records MSI outcome honestly while keeping NSIS mandatory
- wires exact-ref workflow packaging and unsigned artifact upload without GitHub Release
- validates with 78 TypeScript tests, 99 Rust tests, typecheck, Vite build, cargo fmt/check, and diff checks via canonical BL4 app_server

P7 remains IN PROGRESS pending real clean-install/start/restart/uninstall and Linux launch evidence from CI/native runners.

No merge, tag, release, deploy, or public release is included.
